obligations.name: window.initial
obligations.explanation: Empty authorities satisfy the invariant for every supported window width.

obligations.name: window.receive_new
obligations.explanation: Append exactly high+1 only when capacity is available; preserve all older first facts.

obligations.name: window.issue_live_receipt
obligations.explanation: Only a committed live first fact can produce a new authenticated receipt token.

obligations.name: window.confirm_next_receipt
obligations.explanation: The issued-receipt invariant derives confirmed+1<=high and the immutable fact; no direct receiver read is assumed.

obligations.name: window.issue_offer
obligations.explanation: An offer is issued only from the durable sender confirmation prefix.

obligations.name: window.retire_issued_offer
obligations.explanation: An authenticated historical offer implies target<=current confirmed because confirmed is monotone.

obligations.name: window.issue_checkpoint
obligations.explanation: A checkpoint witnesses the current committed floor, not a reconstructed deleted fact.

obligations.name: window.accept_old_or_current_checkpoint
obligations.explanation: Previously issued checkpoints remain at or below current receiver floor; sender floor never decreases.

obligations.name: window.duplicate_or_old_offer
obligations.explanation: An old offer can update observed time but must not delete newly received suffix facts.

obligations.name: window.full_window_denial
obligations.explanation: A valid business denial persists time without adding facts or receipts.

obligations.name: window.retired_delivery_denial
obligations.explanation: Previously retired sequence numbers cannot reenter the live map.

obligations.name: window.query_or_other_business_denial
obligations.explanation: Other read/denial transactions preserve facts but may advance observed time.

obligations.name: window.preauthentication_rejection
obligations.explanation: Rejections before the business transaction do not advance observed time.

obligations.name: window.lost_reply_or_precommit_exit
obligations.explanation: Lost replies and discarded precommit work are logical stutters at an unchanged authority.

obligations.name: window.negative.omit_window_guard
obligations.explanation: A full receiver can exceed its live bound.

obligations.name: replica.fresh_replica
obligations.explanation: An empty replica has no authenticated anchor.

obligations.name: replica.current_guard
obligations.explanation: A current anchored replica reads exactly the current authority image.

obligations.name: replica.cas_read_identity
obligations.explanation: Successful generation CAS binds the proposal to the image used by its transition proof.

obligations.name: replica.authority_commit_local_loss
obligations.explanation: A successful CAS appends a new generation; leaving the old local replica behind cannot rewrite historical images.

obligations.name: replica.atomic_local_commit
obligations.explanation: Installing both the candidate image and its new anchor preserves the replica relation.

obligations.name: replica.recover_historical_snapshot
obligations.explanation: A recovery may install a now-stale authenticated snapshot; the current guard still distinguishes it.

obligations.name: replica.recovery_precommit_stutter
obligations.explanation: A precommit recovery exit changes neither the committed local pair nor authority.

obligations.name: replica.stale_install_frozen
obligations.explanation: After a concurrent authority advance, the recovered generation cannot pass the current guard.

obligations.name: replica.fresh_replica_frozen
obligations.explanation: No-anchor replicas cannot dispatch business through the current-generation gate.

obligations.name: replica.negative.omit_current_guard
obligations.explanation: An internally consistent old image need not be current.
